findings.label: Read-only checksum lacks a disabled/aria affordance
findings.detail: The checksum Input is readOnly required and correctly derived from the chosen source file, but offers no screen-reader cue beyond the native readonly attribute. Optional: add aria-readonly or helper text.

findings.label: Synthetic '(not in current list)' item shows the raw id, not a human label
findings.detail: When a seeded raw_id/dataset_code/artifact_id is absent from the loaded options, the fallback SelectItem label is the opaque id. This is the documented trade-off (no label available for a retired/absent record) and preserves the value rather than dropping it. No action needed.
